text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: This is a species distribution modeling study focused primarily on the invasion risk of the insect pest Thrips palmi under future climate change and land-use scenarios. Although it incorporates future land-use scenarios (SSPs) to refine pest risk mapping, the primary research objective is not land use/land cover (LULC) prediction or simulation itself. The land-use change scenarios are taken from existing SSP-based datasets and used as inputs to filter species distribution outputs rather than as a central focus of LULC modeling. The study does not conduct spatial modeling of LULC with quantitative accuracy metrics or comparisons of LULC models. It is also national in scale but ecological/species-focused rather than LULC-focused. Therefore, it fails core inclusion criteria requiring primary focus on LULC prediction/simulation.)
